# Programiz

> Free interactive platform for learning programming languages with beginner-friendly tutorials, code examples, and reference documentation.

Programiz offers comprehensive courses in Python, JavaScript, Java, SQL, R, C, C++, and more with hands-on examples and certification programs. The platform emphasizes practical learning through code examples and structured tutorials for programmers at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- SQL
- Java
- C++
- TypeScript
- R Programming
- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- Beginner Tutorial
- Code Examples
- Reference Guide
- Certification Courses
- Programiz Pro
- Free Learning
- Getting Started

## Core Programming Courses

- [Programiz: Learn to Code for Free](https://www.programiz.com): Programiz homepage offering free programming courses in Python, JavaScript, Java, SQL and more
- [Learn Python Programming](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming): Main Python programming course page with tutorials and certification
- [Learn SQL](https://www.programiz.com/sql): Main SQL programming course page with tutorials and certification
- [Learn R Programming](https://www.programiz.com/r): Main R programming course page with tutorials and certification

## Python Fundamentals

- [Getting Started with Python](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/getting-started): Beginner tutorial for writing your first Python program
- [Python if, if...else Statement (With Examples)](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/if-elif-else): Tutorial on Python conditional statements with if-elif-else examples
- [Python while Loop (With Examples)](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/while-loop): Guide to Python while loops with code examples and iteration concepts
- [Python List (With Examples)](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/list): Tutorial on Python lists covering creation, modification, and operations
- [Python Dictionary (With Examples)](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/dictionary): Guide to Python dictionaries and key-value pair data structures

## Python Examples & Algorithms

- [Python Examples | Programiz](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/examples): Collection of Python code examples covering loops, functions, data types
- [Python Program to Add Two Numbers](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/examples/add-number): Beginner example program demonstrating basic arithmetic operations
- [Python Program to Check Prime Number](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/examples/prime-number): Python example program for prime number validation with algorithm
- [Python Program to Find the Factorial of a Number](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/examples/factorial): Python example demonstrating factorial calculation algorithm
- [Python Program to Print the Fibonacci sequence](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/examples/fibonacci-sequence): Python example for generating Fibonacci sequence with algorithm
- [Python Program to Check Leap Year](https://www.programiz.com/python-programming/examples/leap-year): Python example for leap year validation using conditional logic
